author: levelsio
text:
Same with this article from yesterday

Gay acceptance is now rapidly dropping in the Netherlands

The real reason is Middle Eastern and North African (MENA) immigrants are extremely against homosexuality

But media isn't allowed or won't ever write that

It's ironic that the gay acceptance we fought for for decades in the Netherlands is being destroyed by progressive policies that keep continously importing low quality immigrants from cultures that are completely opposed to us
